title: Uplift Desk Position Log Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=upliftdesk:desk
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(desk_profile) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Uplift desk position log events land each day and how many distinct desk profile values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Uplift desk position log records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct desk profile values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much Uplift desk position log activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
